Commentary.Commentary: The South African players make their way out in the field. Followed by the dangerous Ewin Lewis and Andre Fletcher. George Linde to start with the first over.

Right Then. A pretty much chasable target for the West Indies batters considering the batting order they possess. Meanwhile, South Africa will need early wickets if they want to level the series. An interesting chase coming up.

West Indies pacers started off poorly and didn't bowl into the right line and lengths. This led them to concede 69 in the first six overs. Kevin Sinclair bowled well and removed both the openers before they could add more fuel to the fire. After getting punished heavily in the powerplay, the bowlers did well to pull things back as they bowled really well in the middle overs. The wickets too kept coming at regular intervals. The bowlers didn't allow other batters to settle in after removing the openers except for Bavuma. But it won't hurt them as the bowlers have given the batters a chance to chase this modest target of 167.

Reeza Hendricks and Quinton de Kock took South Africa to a flying start with Hendricks playing the attacking role. De Kock too supported him knocking a few boundaries. The Proteas scored 69 inside the powerplay. Kevin Sinclair sent both the openers back into the hut soon after that but Bavuma and Miller kept the scoreboard ticking before Miller departed. Bavuma continued to take on the Windies bowlers and got out for 46. The openers set the tone for South Africa and the skipper's innings helped them to put on a fighting total of 166.

Just 3 runs off the last over! This is brilliant bowling from Obed McCoy! Another slower, length ball, outside off. Nortje looks to heave but misses. So, South Africa finishes their innings on 166 for the loss of 7.
SWING AND A MISS! A full ball, outside off. Anrich Nortje looks to push but misses. Can he milk some runs off the last ball?
On the pads. This is flicked to square leg for a single.

OUT! CAUGHT! Back of a length delivery on off, Heinrich Klaasen connects it this time but doesn't get the elevation he needed. His pull shot went straight into the hands of Evin Lewis at deep mid-wicket. Good grab by Lewis as the ball was in the air for a long time. Obed McCoy gets a reward after bowling excellent slower deliveries.
Commentary.Howout: c Evin Lewis b Obed McCoy

Commentary.Commentary: Fuller ball outside off, Klaasen reverse scoops but misses.
Halt in play as Heinrich Klaasen has some issues with his pads.

Slower and shorter on middle, Klaasen pulls it towards deep square leg. He calls for two and gets it comfortably in the end. The keeper fails to collect the throw from the deep. Otherwise, even the dive might not have saved him there.
Yorker on middle. Klaasen digs it out to mid-wicket and runs across. Excellent over from Dwayne Bravo, just 6 runs off his over.
Full delivery, on off. Kagiso Rabada drives it wide of long off, just for single as Holder throws it with his long arms before they run for the second.
SWING AND A MISS! Slower fuller ball, outside off. Rabada goes for the expansive drive but gets beaten.
Slower length ball, way outside off. Heinrich Klaasen gets across and drags his stroke to mid-wicket for one.
On middle. Eased down to long off for one.
Length ball, slower and outside off. Rabada chops it in between the covers and third man for a couple of runs.
Change. Dwayne Bravo is back into the action.
South Africa working on singles here! Another length ball, on off. This is driven to long off for a single. Runs have certainly dried up and wickets are tumbling on the other side.
On middle. Eased down to long of for a single.
A length ball, outside off. Klaasen cuts it wide of sweeper cover and collects a couple.
Fuller and on middle. Rabada flicks it to mid-wicket and gets underway with a single.
Kagiso Rabada is the new men in.
Review taken for LBW. Ball Tracking shows three red and George Linde is a goner.

OUT! LBW! Excellent review taken from the Windies! Fuller ball, angling on middle and leg. Linde looks to flick but misses. Gets hit on the pads The Windies appeals for the LBW but turned down. The windies have a chat and opt for the review. UltraEdge shows no bat. Ball Tracking shows three reds and George Linde has to walk back to the pavilion.
A length ball, outside off. Linde cuts it wide of sweeper cover for a couple of runs.
Change. Obed McCoy is back into the action.
Length ball, on middle. Pushed to mid of for a single. Another excellent over for the windies, 5 runs and a big wicket of Temba Bavuma.
George Linde is the new men in.

OUT! TIMBER! Captain departs for 46 and South Africa are 149 for 5. Pacy fuller delivery, on middle and leg. Temba Bavuma looks to heave it but the ball rolls under the blade and shatters the middle and leg stump.
A length ball, outside off. Klaasen reverse sweeps it to short fine leg for a single.
Another angler, on middle. Bavuma flicks to square leg and takes a single.
Angles this one on fuller ball, on the pads. Heinrich Klaasen flicks it to on side and takes a single
Full and on middle. Bavuma clips it to square leg and takes one.
On middle. Blocked out. Excellent over from Andre Russell just 7 runs and a wicket.

NOT OUT!  Yorker, around off. Temba Bavuma jams it out around the stumps and runs for a quick single. Andre Russell collects the ball and kicks it onto the stumps at the striker's end. A run-out appeal has been sent upstairs. Replay shows Klassen is well in.
FOUR! Hammered! Good length delivery on middle and leg, Temba Bavuma pulls it towards deep mid-wicket for a boundary.
Length delivery on off, cut to point off the back foot for a single. Off the mark straightaway.
Heinrich Klaasen is the new men in.

OUT! TIMBER! Andre Russell strikes! Fuller length on off, Rassie van der Dussen went for the slog but completely mistimes it. The ball came in quickly and the off pole has been shattered. Amazing sight for any bowler. The stump is still cart-wheeling. The dangerous Rassie van der Dussen departs.
Yorker length outside off, Bavuma looks to dig out. The ball goes off the inner half of the bat on the leg side. A single taken.
Change. Andre Russell is back into the action. His figures 1-0-11-0.
Short ball on leg, Bavuma went for the pull but mistimes it. The ball came on the gloves and goes to fine leg. A single to end the over.
Fires a yorker on middle, Bavuma looks to go downtown but gets an inside edge onto the pads.
Slower length on off, swept to deep square leg for a single.
Low full toss on off, Bavuma clips it to long on for a single.
Fuller on pads, Rassie van der Dussen works it towards deep mid-wicket. Call was for two but the fielder is quick to collect and fire the throw.
WIDE! Down the leg side again. Wide called.
Fuller length on off, pushed towards sweeper cover for a single.
FIVE WIDES! Down the leg side, Bavuma misses his sweep. The ball beats the keeper and goes to the fine leg fence. Bonus runs for South Africa.
BEATEN! A slower fuller delivery, outside off. Rassie van der Dussen looks to drive but misses it, was too early on his stroke.
On a length and outside off. Bavuma pushes it to off side and take s a single.
Full ball, outside off. Temba Bavuma swings and misses.

FOUR! A length ball, outside off. Bavuma chops it past point fielder. Andre Russell runs across from third man and dives but as he's hand were on the ball, his legs were touching the rope, boundary given.
SWING AND A MISS! A length ball, outside off. Bavuma misses his slash.
Rassie van der Dussen is the new batsman in.

OUT! CAUGHT! Clean catch and David Miller has to walk back with disappointment!  Fuller delivery, on middle. Miller heaves it to mid-wicket, gets the required elevation but not the distance, the ball goes straight to Andre Fletcher who takes a fantastic low forward diving catch to dismiss David Miller.
Commentary.Howout: c Andre Fletcher b Obed McCoy

Commentary.Commentary: The umpires want to check if the catch is taken clean. The soft signal is OUT! Replay confirms it is taken clean.
Obed McCoy is into the action.
Another full length delivery, outside off. Miller drives it through covers for one.12 runs of the over.
Full ball, way outside off. Bavuma drives it to covers for a single.
Full and on middle. Miller drives it to long on for one.
On the pads. This is flicked to square leg for a asingle.
SIX! Banged! A slower back of a length ball, on middle. Temba Bavuma rocks back and powers it over mid-wicket for a biggie.
Slower full ball, outside off. Miller pushes it to sweeper cover for one.
WIDE! Spills it way outside off, David Miller shoulders arms. Wide called.
Dwayne Bravo is on now.
Very full on middle, Miller jams it towards long on for a single.
FOUR! Lovely shot! Low full toss on off, David Miller drills it through covers for a boundary.
Fuller length outside off, Miller goes for the drive but gets beaten on the outside edge.
Slower and full outside off, Bavuma drives it to mid off. The fielder does well to put in a dive and save a boundary for the side. A single taken.
Back of a length delivery on off, Bavuma looks to pull but misses.
Fuller length on off, Miller whips it to deep mid-wicket for a run.
Fuller length, on middle, Miller squeezes it out to long on for a single. Kevin Sinclair finishes his spell. His figures, 4-0-23-2
Flatter ball outside off, pushed past covers for a single.
FOUR! Shorter ball on off, Bavuma rocks back and punches it to deep mid-wicket for a boundary.
Outside off, cut towards point for a single.
David Miller is the new man in.

OUT! LBW! Tossed up delivery on leg, Reeza Hendricks goes for the paddle scoop but misses. The ball hits his knee and goes behind the keeper. Sinclair makes a shout for an LBW. The umpire takes a long time before raising his finger. Reeza Hendricks takes a review. Ultra Edge confirms no bat involved. The Ball Tracker shows umpire's call on hitting the stumps. Kevin Sinclair removes both the openers.
Fired on the pads, Bavuma goes for the slog but misses. The ball rolls on the off side after hitting the thigh pad.
Darted on the pads. Flicked to square leg for a single. Fabian Allen finishes off his spell, his figures 4-0-35-0.
Loopy ball, outside off. This is pushed to the off side and a single is taaken.
On middle. Temba Bavuma paddles it to fine leg for one.
FOUR! Welcome Boundary!  Pitched up, outside off. Temba Bavuma gets low and drives it through covers for a boundary.
Full and on middle. Temba Bavuma paddles it to short fine leg for one.
Darted on the pads. Flicked to square leg for a single.
On middle. This si pushed to off side for a single.
Darted on the pads. This is flicked to square leg for a single.
Another one on middle. Eased down to long of for a single.
On middle. Eased down to long of for a single.
BEATEN! Loopy ball, outside off. Reeza Hendricks looks to defend but misses.
Tossed up, on middle. Temba Bavuma paddles it to short fine leg and takes a single.
Flatter ball, outside off. Temba Bavuma pushes it to covers and sneak a single. Just 4 coming of the over.
Short on middle. Temba Bavuma looks to heave but gets inner half of the bat, back to the bowler.
Loopy ball, on middle. Reeza Hendricks tucks it to mid-wicket for one.
On middle. Blocked out.
Two is the call, but adjusts with a single! On middle. Temba Bavuma flicks it to mid-wicket and takes a single.
Tossed up, on off. This is pushed to long of for a single.
Change. Fabian Allen is back into the action.
FOUR! Fuller ball outside off, Temba Bavuma reverse sweeps it past point for a boundary. Excellent start for the skipper.
The South Africa captain, Temba Bavuma is the new men in.

OUT! CAUGHT BEHIND! Loopy delivery on off, de Kock looks to scoop it behind but misses. The ball goes off the gloves to Nicholas Pooran who grabs it putting a dive to his left. Sinclair and Pooran are confident and appeal for the catch. The umpire is not interested. West Indies take a review. Ultra Edge confirms there is a spike. The decision is overturned and Kevin Sinclair has provided the first breakthrough. He does an interesting celebration after that.
Commentary.Howout: c Nicholas Pooran b Kevin Sinclair

Commentary.Commentary: Review has been taken for CAUGHT BEHIND. UltraEdge shows there is a spike as the ball passes the glove and Quinton de Kock is a goner.
Tossed up on off, Hendricks reverse sweeps it to third man for a single.
Quicker delivery on off, worked towards backward point for a single.
Full on the middle, eased down to long on for a single.
Touch shorter outside off, punched towards long on for a run.
Outside off, de Kock looks to hit but misses. The ball hits his pads and goes towards the fine leg region. A leg bye taken. End of the powerplay. South Africa 69 for no loss.
Fuller length outside off, followed Hendricks as he moved across, he paddle scoops it on the leg side. A single taken.
WIDE! Outside off and outside the tramline again. Wided.
FOUR! Runs flowing for South Africa! Length delivery on off, Reeza Hendricks cuts it towards deep backward point for a boundary. He moves onto 33.
WIDE! Way too outside off, Hendricks leaves it alone. Wided.
Slower delivery on off, guided to point.
Fuller length on off, Hendricks drives it towards the deep point region and bags a couple of runs. Good fielding in the deep as the fielder dives and saves two.
Fullish delivery on leg, whipped to deep mid-wicket for a single.
FOUR! Another boundary! That is really poor from Dre Russ! Width on offer outside off, Reeza Hendricks slices it past point for a boundary. 11 runs off the over.
Fuller length on middle, flicked to deep mid-wicket for a single.
Short ball on middle, de Kock sways away from it.
SIX! HIGH AND HANDSOME! Fuller length on middle, Quinton de Kock muscles it over deep square leg for a maximum. Fifty up for South Africa as well.
Back of a length on off, de Kock paddles it to square leg.
Short on leg, de Kock misses his shot.
Andre Russell comes into the attack.

FOUR LEG BYES! Darted on the pads. Reeza Hendricks misses his flick, gets hit on the pads and the ball rolls over, past short fine leg for four leg byes. The Proteas are not messing around and clearly not wasting any balls, after what happened in the 1st match.
On middle. Defended out.
FOUR! Moves to 23 in no time! Another fuller ball, outside off. Reeza Hendricks slices it over the short third man fielder, as the ball races away to the fence.
On middle. Blocked back to the bowler.
FOUR! Good Shot! Full and outside off. Reeza Hendricks makes room and uppishly drives it over covers for a boundary.
SIX! The proteas are already on the upper gear! Loopy ball, on off. Reeza Hendricks makes a bit of room and smokes it over long of for a biggie.
Outside off. Pushed to covers.

Appeal but turned down! A full ball, around off. Quinton de Kock steps a bit across and looks to heave but misses. Gets hit on the pads. Jason Holder appeals for LBW but nothing from the umpire. Looks like it was missing off stump.
FOUR! Make it 14! Another length ball, outside off. Quinton de Kock looks to cut it but gets a thick outside edge through gully region for a boundary.
SIX! Cracked! Full ball, outside off. Quinton de Kock steps across on off side and heaves it over the mid-wicket region for a biggie. 10 runs of the first three deliveries.
FOUR! Good shot! Fuller ball, slanting across, wide of outside off. Quinton de Kock stays low and lofts it over the covers for a boundary.
A length ball, outside off. Quinton de Kock slaps it straight to cover fielder.
Change. Jason Holder is into the action.
Flatter on off. Reeza Hendricks drives it to the left of bowler.
FOUR! First boundary of the innings! Loopy ball, on off. Reeza Hendricks drives it over the bowlers head for four.
Tossed up, on middle. Quinton de Kock pushes it on the off side and takes one.
FOUR Byes! Flatter ball, outside off. Quinton de Kock looks to play the reverse sweep but misses it, The ball rolls away from the keeper and runs away to thrid man for a boundary.
Darted on the pads. Reeza Hendricks flicks it to mid-wicket, where Dwayne Bravo dives to his right and keeps it for single.
Pitches it up, outside off. Hendricks pushes it through covers for a couple.
Who will bowl from the other end. It is Fabian Allen.
Just 3 from the first over! Loppy ball, outside off. Quinton de Kock punches it off the back foot to covers.
Loopy ball, on middle. Hendricks flicks it to deep mid-wicket and takes a single.
On middle. Blocked out.
Darted on the pads. Flicked to mid-wicket.
Another tossed up, outside off. Quinton de Kock pushes it to covers and gets off the mark with a single.
Starts with a tossed up ball, on middle. Reeza Hendricks punches it to long on for a single. South Africa and Reeza Hendricks are underway.
The players are out on the field. Reeza Hendricks and Quinton de Kock are the openers for South Africa. Kevin Sinclair will open the bowling for the hosts. Hendricks to face. Here we go then...
Pitch report - Samuel Badree says it is the same strip and the batters would continue to go big and the bowler's have to use their variation.
Temba Bavuma says they wanted to bowl first as well, adds that they will look to execute the plan well today. Ends by saying they will try to score more and give their bowlers a good total to defend.

Kieron Pollard says they will go unchanged, Says their strength is to hit sixes and they will look to rotate the strikes more. Ends by saying, they are not taking South Africa lightly, they are strong and will come back.

South Africa (Playing XI): Reeza Hendricks, Quinton de Kock(w), Temba Bavuma(c), Rassie van der Dussen, Heinrich Klaasen, David Miller, George Linde, Kagiso Rabada, Anrich Nortje, Tabraiz Shamsi, Lungi Ngidi
West Indies (Playing XI): Evin Lewis, Andre Fletcher, Chris Gayle, Nicholas Pooran(w), Kieron Pollard(c), Andre Russell, Jason Holder, Dwayne Bravo, Fabian Allen, Obed McCoy, Kevin Sinclair
TOSS - West Indies have won the toss and ELECTED TO BOWL FIRST.

Less than 24 hours is what the visitors have had to get over their battering from the first game. Is that much time enough to actually get over that beating? Is that much time enough to reflect on what went wrong and what probably could have been done right? Well, it has to be as a loss for South Africa here will mean, they will be facing an uphill task to let alone win the series but just to stay alive. However, knowing the proteas, you can surely expect them to comeback stronger. For the Windies, a repeat of yesterday is what they would love. Will we see another one-sided affair or will there by an equal competition between bat and ball this time? Welcome to the coverage of the second T20I. Stay tuned for further updates.
